frozen_left_inverse_iteration.scope: Exact-arithmetic iteration with B=(J^T J)^(-1) J^T fixed at the center; solves the projected equations, not necessarily least squares.

finite_noise_bounds.scope: Any point in the stated ball with residual at most the noise bound has source error at most 4 gamma epsilon.

mean_span.scope: Top-r mean span in the fixed covariance gauge; no unobserved directions are inferred.
